old_heldout_previously_seen: Q3 and user screenshots; no new candidate predictions or selection on these images, no fresh independent-test claim

unchanged_A28_gates.empty_region_policy: report null recall if no GT positives; no claim of protection from an empty set
unchanged_A28_gates.ranking_after_all_gates: descending 512 AH macro Dice, then fewer distance filters, shorter length, lower margin, lower penalty, candidate ID
unchanged_A28_gates.no_eligible_candidate: REJECT_R2_FAMILY_FOR_PL; preserve all runs, do not relax gates; next revision requires its own preregistration

scope: Diagnostic continuous features only; no segmentation candidates, no quality acceptance, no heldout or VK scoring

processing.branches: Original green and unchanged Gaussian3 green before LUT. Uint8 only. Features accept images only; no labels, FOV or bright-region masks.
processing.bank: Two scales sigma1/length5 and sigma1.5/length9, eight angles k*pi/8. Continuous rectangle abs(u)<=3sigma and abs(v)<=floor(length/2) sampled on integer grid. Dark-line kernel mean(g)-g, signed derivative u*g/sigma^2. Each positive coefficient sum normalized to256 then nearest-even integer; center corrected to exact zero DC. All16 coefficient matrices frozen here.
processing.correlation: Replicate boundaries. Integer sum normalized by positive coefficient sum to Q8 units with floor((sum*256+den//2)/den). Signed rounding ties towards positive infinity. Independent spatial-sum oracle verifies full images.
processing.edge: Signed normalized derivative is averaged over31x31, one half-up integer rounding, then absolute. Pair with winning MF direction/scale; first-index ties. Do not average absolute values.
processing.mf: Small scale and large scale each maximum of eight directions clipped at0. Global maximum over16 similarly clipped.
processing.shape: mf_max*256//(256+paired_edge). Custom fixed local ratio; not original published adaptive MF-FDOG threshold.
processing.coherence: 7x7 count of positive-MF neighbors with same or circular-adjacent winning direction bin, count*256/49 half up; uint16. Coherent shape=shape*coherence/256 half up.
processing.rank: All ranks larger implies more vessel-like. Store 65535-paired_edge for the two edge-only maps. Other maps as calculated; A response*256.

diagnostic_groups.fov: Original frozen FOV; original AH positives and negative controls.
diagnostic_groups.bright_C2: Original15x15 bright band (Gaussian>=192 core dilation minus core) intersect C2; compare retained true and false C2 pixels.
diagnostic_groups.outside_C2: Original FOV excluding C2; true AH vessel versus background, tests addition evidence.
diagnostic_groups.long_missing_vs_near_bg: Positive: GT Zhang skeleton outside C2 whose8connected missed component has>3 pixels. Negative: original nonvessel pixels outside C2 within square15x15 dilation of full GT skeleton. Component size is not gap length. GT-derived group ONLY for diagnosis, never used in feature generation or future runtime.

statistics.per_image_and_pooled: Record positives/negatives/prevalence, tied-rank ROC AUC, noninterpolated average precision over all unique levels. Either class empty => AUC/AP null. Pooled256 and512 separately, no claim of heldout accuracy.
statistics.optimistic_removal: Over all thresholds choose highest preserving C2 bright TP up to loss floor(0.02*ALL original AH bright-band positives). Gives same-sample scalar separation ceiling under this recall budget only. Other gates and individual-image protection not satisfied by this calculation.
statistics.optimistic_addition: Over all thresholds outside C2, maximize added TP at exact>=80% AH precision; tie highest threshold. No feasible nonempty threshold => null. Not a chosen classifier; threshold is fit on same sample and optimistic.
statistics.no_hypothesis_test: No p-values, crossvalidated/clinical performance or independence claims. Diagnostic exploration after four failed families; continuous feature inventory fixed before inspecting real responses.

decision: Interpret response discrimination before another finite segmentation protocol. Do not deploy any diagnostic threshold or claim gates passed. Keep121 prior rejected candidates count unchanged. A future image-only classifier needs its own frozen finite protocol and ALL original gates plus full PL/board validation.
additional_C2_requirements: Original256 thin/clDice nondecrease and both-size GT skeleton adjacent-edge coverage nondecrease also remain. No gates relaxed.
reuse: Read previously verified training arrays. Reuse OpenCV filter2D offline and original Gaussian/FOV; future hardware would reuse existing2017.4 Filter2D/LineBuffer/Window/DMA infrastructure, but hardware cost remains unknown.
reference_scope: Zhang et al2010 motivates paired Gaussian dark-line and derivative responses, two scales and31x31 signed mean. Custom integer coefficients, winner pairing, fixed ratio and coherence are not a full published method reproduction. No borrowed accuracy claims.
